title: La 7.5 %–Sc 1 % co-doped BiFeO3 memristive synapse: measurement, analysis and simulation code
description: Code accompanying the paper "Reduced-leakage (La, Sc) co-doped BiFeO3 memristive synapse with statistically characterized analog weight updates": Keithley 2602 TSP/Lua measurement protocols, data preparation (synaptic metrics, PUND, conduction, XRD fits, update statistics), OriginPro plotting scripts, CrossSim 2.0 device-parameter extraction and MNIST training (with results), and assembly of the paper figures.
